game: Georgia State Panthers@Arkansas State Red Wolves

guide_enrichment.narrative:
Our narrower view of Arkansas State’s advantage starts with Georgia State’s passing game. Our matchup data identifies a major efficiency advantage for Georgia State through the air against an Arkansas State pass defense that has struggled. Cameran Brown has completed 67.9 percent of his passes, while Georgia State’s offensive line has allowed only two sacks on 151 pass attempts. That combination gives the underdog a credible way to keep this game close.

We are not treating Georgia State’s 42-10 win over Old Dominion as proof of what comes next, but Brown’s six-touchdown, interception-free performance showed the ceiling of this passing attack. The concern is that our underlying numbers are less impressed by Georgia State’s ability to create scoring opportunities consistently, even though it has converted 20 of 22 red-zone possessions. For us, those conflicting signals explain both the modest disagreement with the market and why there is not enough value to back Arkansas State at the available price.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch: We are watching Brown and Georgia State’s pass protection against the Arkansas State secondary. Brown accounts for more than half of Georgia State’s total offense, and Rodshaun Dorsey has produced six touchdown catches on only 18 receptions. If Georgia State protects Brown and generates explosive passing plays, Arkansas State may have difficulty creating the separation the market is asking it to produce.

recent_game.fact: Georgia State defeated Old Dominion 42-10 in its conference opener on Oct. 3.
Quarterback Cameran Brown passed for a career-high 284 yards and a program-record six touchdowns without an interception against Old Dominion.
Freshman running back Qwantavius Wiggins led Georgia State with 87 rushing yards and averaged 5.8 yards per carry against Old Dominion.
Georgia State held Old Dominion to a program-record-low 146 total yards, including 79 passing and 67 rushing.
Georgia State recorded seven sacks and 11 tackles for loss against Old Dominion.
Xavier Esqillion recorded five tackles, three sacks, three tackles for loss and two forced fumbles against Old Dominion.

opponent_notes.fact: Georgia State is scheduled to play Arkansas State in Jonesboro, Arkansas, on Oct. 24, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET.

quarterback.fact: Cameran Brown is Georgia State's starting quarterback and has completed 89 of 131 passes for 1,157 yards, 12 touchdowns and four interceptions through five games.
Brown has a 67.9 percent completion rate and has added 112 rushing yards and one rushing touchdown.

Backup quarterback Ayden Pereira, a Merrimack transfer, has 49 passing yards, 44 rushing yards and one rushing touchdown this season.
